2609.04304.title: Iris: Climbing to the Search Frontier
2609.04304.paper_summary: We present Iris-mini and Iris-pro, two search agents trained at the 35B-A3B and 397B-A17B scales, together with the data pipeline and training recipe behind them. Tasks are reverse-constructed from the hyperlink structure of a web corpus: we author multi-hop chains over an entity graph distilled from a seed page and its out-links, rewrite every non-answer entity into a descriptive reference so that no clue can be resolved by string matching, and admit only questions that a reference model fails closed-book yet solves once the supporting evidence is supplied. These questions are then turned into trajectories, which are filtered at both the trajectory and the turn level before SFT. The policy is then optimized by RL against live search, with the reward judge and the observation summarizer served inside the training cluster, and with over-long rollouts interrupted at the request level and resumed from their committed prefix at the next step. We alternate the two stages in a procedure we call SFT-RL climbing, returning the hardest solved and most efficient rollouts of each RL round to the next supervised pass. Because inference-time context management is worth more on these benchmarks than most reported differences between systems, we evaluate every benchmark both with and without it, holding the tool set, the context limit, and the judge fixed. All results come from a single ReAct agent, with no sub-agents and no test-time verification. With management enabled, on BrowseComp, BrowseComp-ZH, DeepSearchQA, and HLE the two models reach $82.2/84.8/86.9/52.3$ and $88.6/85.1/92.9/56.4$, the strongest overall results among open-source search agents in their respective parameter ranges. We plan to release the model weights together with the complete recipe for data construction, training, and evaluation.
2609.04304.paper_summary_zh: 我們介紹了Iris-mini和Iris-pro，這兩個搜索代理在35B-A3B和397B-A17B規模上進行訓練，並展示了它們背後的數據管道和訓練配方。任務是從網頁語料庫的超鏈接結構中反向構建的：我們在從種子頁面及其外部鏈接提煉出的實體圖上編寫多跳鏈，將每個非答案實體重寫為描述性參考，以便沒有線索可以通過字符串匹配來解決，並僅接受參考模型在閉卷時失敗但在提供支持證據後能解決的問題。這些問題隨後被轉換為軌跡，並在SFT之前在軌跡和轉折層面上進行過濾。然後，該策略通過RL針對實時搜索進行優化，獎勵評判和觀察摘要器在訓練集群內提供，並且過長的回合在請求層面中斷，並在下一步從其已承諾的前綴恢復。我們在一個稱為SFT-RL攀登的程序中交替進行這兩個階段，將每個RL回合中最難解決和最有效的回合返回到下一個監督通過。由於推理時的上下文管理在這些基準中比系統之間報告的差異更具價值，我們在評估每個基準時都同時考慮了有無上下文管理，並固定工具集、上下文限制和評判標準。所有結果均來自單個ReAct代理，沒有子代理和測試時驗證。在啟用管理的情況下，在BrowseComp、BrowseComp-ZH、DeepSearchQA和HLE上，這兩個模型達到$82.2/84.8/86.9/52.3$和$88.6/85.1/92.9/56.4$，在其各自參數範圍內是開源搜索代理中最強的整體結果。我們計劃釋放模型權重以及數據構建、訓練和評估的完整配方。
